terra.problem: The passage does not say the first book starts at the beginning of Jesus’ work.
John baptizing in the Jordan and the place of Jesus’ baptism in the story are facts from outside the passage, but neither has a reference.
“Wrong group” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer, which Papa never does.
The claim that scribes copied and taught the Law is from outside the passage and needs a reference.
“He wanted them to be sure” gives Jesus a reason the passage does not state.
The joke’s ending does not follow clearly: it is unclear what leaving cookies in the oven has to do with what Papa would do to a friend.
“So they asked” presents hearing about the kingdom as the reason for their question. The passage does not give their reason.
“Same reason” equates the times Jesus discusses here with the timing of the Marriage Supper, a connection the passage does not state. When the Supper’s timing comes up, Papa points to Matthew 24:36.
Jesus says they will be His witnesses. The explanation changes this future statement to “They’re telling others about Him,” which the passage does not say they are doing yet.
The passage names Jerusalem first, but it does not say the apostles are standing in Jerusalem when Jesus speaks.
Papa brings up not guessing when the big day will come but does not point to Matthew 24:36.
“That’s good news for everybody” makes a universal claim about Jesus’ return that the passage does not make.
